description: This file implements a global logging utility for the Mattermost project, providing functions to initialize, retrieve, and emit logs at various levels, with thread-safe access to a shared logger instance.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: A logger object used for emitting log messages at various levels.

methods.name: InitGlobalLogger
methods.description: Initializes the global logger with a provided Logger instance, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: getGlobalLogger
methods.description: Retrieves the current global logger instance with thread-safe read lock.

methods.name: IsLevelEnabled
methods.description: Checks if at least one log target is enabled for the specified log level.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Emits a log message at a specified level with optional fields.

methods.name: LogM
methods.description: Emits log messages for multiple levels with optional fields.

methods.name: Trace
methods.description: Logs a message at the Trace level.

methods.name: Debug
methods.description: Logs a message at the Debug level.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Logs a message at the Info level.

methods.name: Warn
methods.description: Logs a message at the Warn level.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Logs a message at the Error level.

methods.name: Critical
methods.description: Deprecated; calls Fatal to log critical messages.

methods.name: Fatal
methods.description: Logs a message at the Fatal level.
